title: The Last Supper
tone: Drawn as a Renaissance cartoon (the full-size outline drawing a fresco is transferred from): calm contour lines, strong horizontals, one-point perspective only hinted.
source: Leonardo da Vinci, The Last Supper, Santa Maria delle Grazie, Milan; Gospel accounts (retold)

episodes.title: A wall for a refectory
episodes.scene: Duke Ludovico Sforza asks Leonardo to paint the end wall of the monks' dining hall.
episodes.keyImage: A long bare wall with an arched top; a single small figure looking up at it; a table below.

episodes.title: Days of looking
episodes.scene: Leonardo stands for whole days before the wall without painting, then adds a single stroke and leaves.
episodes.keyImage: A figure on a scaffold, arm raised with a brush, facing a wall where a few outlines have appeared.

episodes.title: One of you will betray me
episodes.scene: At the supper Jesus says one of the twelve will betray him; the disciples recoil in waves of gesture.
episodes.keyImage: A long table across the scene; a calm central figure with arms spread; on each side figures leaning away in groups of three, hands raised.

episodes.title: The purse
episodes.scene: Judas pulls back, clutching a small bag of silver, his face in shadow.
episodes.keyImage: One seated figure in profile recoiling to the left, a small purse in his fist, an overturned salt cellar on the table.

episodes.title: The fading wall
episodes.scene: Painted in tempera on dry plaster, the picture begins to flake within decades; monks cut a door through Jesus's feet.
episodes.keyImage: The table and figures with gaps in their outlines, flakes drifting down; a doorway cut through the bottom centre.

episodes.scene: Allied bombs destroy the refectory roof; the painted wall, braced with sandbags, survives.
episodes.keyImage: A broken roof line and open sky; a single wall still standing, propped by a stack of sandbags.

episodes.title: Twenty-two years
episodes.scene: Restorers work square centimetre by centimetre until 1999 to recover what Leonardo painted.
episodes.keyImage: A restorer on a scaffold with a small lamp, close to the wall; the outlines behind her coming back clean.
